# (B) How to Reduce Paying Total Interest and Save Money Overall!

Part (A) shows that by making 360 equal monthly payments of about $2,812, the total interest of the loan (after 3 years) amounted to $1.243184e+04 or $12,431.84. By paying $5,000.00, namely, ($5,000.00 – $2,812.00) = $2,188 more per monthly payment, the following computation in R shows the concomitant benefit!

```
> amort.table(Loan=1000000, pmt=5000,
+ i=0.025, pf=12, plot=TRUE)
> # Outputting:
> $Schedule
```
